definitions.explanation: The same size as the real thing. Used for models, replicas, and reproductions.

examples.japanese: {実物大|じつぶつだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模型|もけい}→模型：07079_mokei⟧。
{実物大|じつぶつだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ガンダム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to see the life-size Gundam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{恐竜|きょうりゅう}→恐竜：10428_kyouryuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実物大|じつぶつだい}⟦レプリカ→レプリカ：28446_repurika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{実物大|じつぶつだい} describes something made at the same size as the real thing. Used for models, replicas, statues, and reproductions.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{実物|じつぶつ}→実物：04215_jitsubutsu⟧ (actual thing) + {大|だい} (size).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実物大|じつぶつだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模型|もけい}→模型：07079_mokei⟧: life-size model
- {実物大|じつぶつだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レプリカ→レプリカ：28446_repurika⟧: full-scale replica
- {実物大|じつぶつだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧: life-size statue

SIMILAR 〜{大|だい} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{原寸大|げんすんだい}→原寸大：20738_gensundai⟧: actual/original size (more technical)
- ⟦{等身大|とうしんだい}→等身大：16861_toushindai⟧: life-size (specifically human-sized); also used figuratively meaning "true to oneself" or "realistic"

USAGE:
Typically modifies nouns with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {実物大|じつぶつだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜. Often encountered at museums, theme parks, and exhibitions where large-scale replicas are displayed.
